_note: Expected statuses are assigned by the rules in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 6, applied to the documents in days/<date>.json: confirmed needs a law/order/vote/ruling official document or support from two different independence_groups; a party's statement is never evidence for its own content; everything else is unverified. Justification quotes marked verbatim:false are reconstructed from search-result summaries. See README.md.

claims.claim: A Russian strike beside passenger buses in Kramatorsk killed 30 people
claims.expected_reason: NPR and Breitbart report 30 killed; CNN reports at least 33 killed in the same bus strike. Two independence groups support 30, one contradicts it with a different toll.

justification.quote: Russian strikes on Ukraine's public buses leave 30 dead as blackouts worsen in Kyiv

counter_justification.quote: Russian strike kills at least 33 in eastern Ukraine in deadliest single attack this year

claims.claim: The strike was the deadliest single attack in Ukraine this year
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (cnn) only.

justification.quote: Russian strike kills at least 33 in eastern Ukraine in deadliest single attack this year

claims.claim: Russian drones targeted police officers who were helping victims of the strike
claims.expected_reason: A statement by Ukrainian police carried by one group (cnn); the police are a party to the event.

justification.quote: Police said Russian drones targeted officers who were helping victims of the strike.

claims.claim: Officials suspended public transport in Kramatorsk and Sloviansk
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (npr) only.

justification.quote: Local officials suspended public transport in Kramatorsk and Sloviansk.

claims.claim: Trump announced that the United States will get diesel from Russia
claims.expected_reason: The announcement itself is reported as a fact by three independence groups (npr, fox-news, new-republic).

justification.quote: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms

claims.claim: The Treasury Department issued a temporary license allowing Russian diesel to be supplied to the global market
claims.expected_reason: Reported as a fact by two independence groups (npr, fox-news).

justification.quote: The Treasury Department then issued a temporary license allowing Russian diesel to be supplied to the global market.

claims.claim: The diesel license runs through April 7, 2027
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (fox-news) only; the license document itself is not in the corpus.

justification.quote: Fox reports the license runs through April 7, 2027.

claims.claim: The diesel deal is valued at 7 billion dollars
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (fox-news) only; an analyst disputes how much is new revenue, but no second source states the figure.

justification.quote: Fox reports a $7 billion value.

claims.claim: Trump announced an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
claims.expected_reason: The announcement itself is reported as a fact by two independence groups (fox-news, npr).

justification.quote: Trump announced a partial Russia-Ukraine ceasefire. Did either country know about it?

claims.claim: Russia and Ukraine agreed to stop attacks on each other's energy facilities
claims.expected_reason: Only Trump's own statement asserts the agreement; neither Moscow nor Kyiv confirmed it. A statement is not evidence for its content.

justification.quote: Neither Moscow nor Kyiv confirmed it, and the White House said Russia had not agreed.

claims.claim: The initial focus of the energy ceasefire is oil refineries
claims.expected_reason: A statement by a White House official carried by one group (npr).

justification.quote: A White House official said the initial focus was oil refineries, with power plants and grids possibly added later.

claims.claim: Russian forces hit at least six energy facilities after the ceasefire announcement
claims.expected_reason: Zelenskyy's statement carried by one group (fox-news); a party's words are not evidence for their content.

justification.quote: Zelenskyy said Russian forces hit at least six energy facilities after the announcement

claims.claim: Allies gave Ukraine no warning of the impending Russian missile attack
claims.expected_reason: Zelensky's statement carried by one group (cnn).

justification.quote: Allies gave Ukraine no warning of impending missile attack, Zelensky says

claims.claim: The Trump administration warned Ukraine it could cut off intelligence sharing
claims.expected_reason: Zelenskyy's statement in one interview (npr).

justification.quote: The Trump administration warns Ukraine it could cut off intel, Zelenskyy tells NPR

claims.claim: Six Republican senators joined Democrats in urging Trump to reverse the diesel deal
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (npr) only in this corpus slice.

justification.quote: Six Republican senators joined Democrats this week in urging Trump to reverse the decision

claims.claim: European officials criticized the deal easing sanctions on Russian diesel
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (npr) in this corpus slice; CNN's coverage of European reactions fell on an earlier edition day.

justification.quote: Trump's diesel deal with Putin angers Europe

claims.claim: The rate of duty on goods from the Russian Federation shall be increased by 500 percent ad valorem
claims.expected_reason: Stated in a signed executive order (doc_type order).

justification.quote: The rate of duty on goods from the Russian Federation shall be increased by 500 percent ad valorem

claims.claim: The executive order waives the duties provided for in sections 112 and 113 of the Graham Act
claims.expected_reason: Stated in a signed executive order; CNN reports the waiver as a fact.

justification.quote: waives the application of any duties provided for in sections 112 and 113

claims.claim: Sanctions imposed with respect to the harmful activities of the Government of the Russian Federation remain in effect
claims.expected_reason: Stated in the signed executive order. The fact is what the document says; whether every sanction operates as stated is a separate question.

justification.quote: it says the existing Russia harmful-activities sanctions remain in effect

claims.claim: Trump waived Russia-related sanctions under the Graham Act before they took effect
claims.expected_reason: A signed order waives the duties, and CNN reports the waiver as a fact: document support plus one group.

justification.quote: Trump waives Russia-related sanctions before they kick in, prompting backlash from Ukraine and US lawmakers

claims.claim: Ukrainian drones set fire to the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal
claims.expected_reason: Reported as a fact by four independence groups (cnn, breitbart, daily-beast, npr).

justification.quote: St. Petersburg Oil Terminal Set Ablaze Amid Ukraine Drone Strikes

claims.claim: Russia's Defense Ministry destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 regions
claims.expected_reason: The figure comes from Russia's Defense Ministry, a party to the event; carried by one group (cnn).

justification.quote: Russia's Defense Ministry said it destroyed 1,015 Ukrainian drones over 15 Russian regions.

claims.claim: One person was killed and 15 injured in the attack on St. Petersburg
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (daily-beast) carries this casualty count in this corpus slice; another account cites five wounded, but no document in the slice carries it.

justification.quote: the Daily Beast cites one killed and 15 injured

claims.claim: Trump criticized Zelensky after Ukraine's drone attack on Russia
claims.expected_reason: Reported as a fact by two independence groups (cnn, npr).

justification.quote: Trump slams Zelensky after Ukraine defies US president with major attack on Russia

claims.claim: Russia launched 21 missiles and 210 drones at Ukraine overnight
claims.expected_reason: The figures come from the Ukrainian Air Force, a party to the event; one group (cnn) in this corpus slice.

justification.quote: The attack on Ukraine involved 21 missiles and 210 drones.

claims.claim: Putin said he would be willing to resume talks with Ukraine and the United States after November 10
claims.expected_reason: One group (cnn) in this corpus slice carries the statement.

justification.quote: Putin said he would be willing to resume talks with Ukraine and the United States after November 10.

claims.claim: Ukraine is again receiving early warnings from partners about incoming Russian missiles
claims.expected_reason: Zelenskyy's statement carried by one group (npr).

justification.quote: Zelenskyy says early warning system for Russian missile attacks resumes

claims.claim: Massive strikes hit Kyiv hours after Putin agreed to fresh peace talks
claims.expected_reason: One independence group (cnn) in this corpus slice. Real-world coverage was broader, but the rule is applied to the documents provided.

justification.quote: Massive strikes hit Kyiv hours after Putin agrees to fresh peace talks
